svg.title: VarMQ worker lifecycle
svg.desc: A state diagram of the seven worker states, next to a worker that walks through them. Created with WithAutoRun(false), the worker is Initiated and three added jobs wait. Start makes it Idle, and it is Running once job 1 starts. Pause while job 1 runs makes it Pausing; job 1 finishes, and the worker is Paused while jobs 2 and 3 wait. Resume makes it Idle, then Running job 2. Stop while job 2 runs makes it Stopping; job 2 finishes, the goroutines go, and the worker is Stopped while job 3 stays waiting. Restart makes it Idle, then Running job 3, then Idle again.
svg.text: dashed = on its way to the next state
Stop() works from Idle, Running, Pausing or Paused.
the running job finishes, no new one starts
loop ended; waiting jobs stay queued
the running job finishes, then goroutines exit
Pause and Stop never interrupt a running job.
